verdict.rationale: Marlin runs autonomously for hours once a topic is set, but that autonomy is inside its own interactive product, which begins with a brief exchange with the user. There is no evidence of an API, CLI, or headless/CI invocation mode, and probes for OpenAPI specs and llms.txt all returned 404. Autonomous long-running execution is an adjacent capability, not headless or CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
